response.sql: WITH player_counts AS (SELECT p.player_id, COUNT(ma.player_id) AS award_count FROM player AS p LEFT JOIN manager_award AS ma ON ma.player_id = p.player_id GROUP BY p.player_id), totals AS (SELECT SUM(award_count) AS total_awards FROM player_counts) SELECT pc.player_id, pc.award_count, 1.0 * pc.award_count / NULLIF(t.total_awards, 0) AS fraction FROM player_counts AS pc CROSS JOIN totals AS t WHERE t.total_awards IS NOT NULL ORDER BY fraction DESC NULLS LAST, pc.player_id LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: player_id identifies each player in the player table.
If players exist but none has a manager award, the zero total produces a NULL fraction.
